text.id: Hari 5. Senin. Seminggu persis sejak Sekar pamit ke Dinda.
text.en: Day 5. Monday. Exactly a week since Sekar said goodbye to Dinda.

text.id: Foto subuh itu masih kebuka di HP Sekar waktu gue bangun. Dermaga kayu, bakau, kapal biru-putih. "Masih di sana."
text.en: The dawn photo is still open on Sekar's phone when I wake up. A wooden jetty, mangroves, a blue and white boat. "Still there."

text.id: Gue nggak ke kampus. Udah izin ke dosen. Bilangnya sakit.
text.en: I'm not going to campus. I told my lecturer I'm sick.

text.id: Pak Yusuf juga nelpon tadi pagi. Katanya ada polisi yang lewat depan gang tiap dua jam. Gue nggak tahu harus lega atau tambah takut.
text.en: Inspector Yusuf called this morning too. He says a patrol will come past the alley every two hours. I don't know if I should feel relieved or more scared.

text.id: Dan Bima nggak ke polisi. Satu hari yang dia minta udah lewat. Gue cek ke Pak Yusuf, nggak ada laporan apa-apa.
text.en: And Bima didn't go to the police. The one day he asked for is up. I checked with Inspector Yusuf, there's no statement from him.

text.id: Bima ngechat gue jam dua pagi. "Bilang ke Raka, gue mau ngomong. Yang bener." Abis itu dia hapus.
text.en: Bima texted me at two in the morning. "Tell Raka I want to talk. Properly." Then he deleted it.

text.id: Jadi. Semalem kita bilang ke mana dulu?
text.en: So. Where did we say we'd start last night?

text.id: Dermaga. Kapal Pak Karta. Kalau Pak Hendra nggak mau ngomong, gue cari orang yang dulu pegang kapal itu.
text.en: The pier. Pak Karta's boat. If Pak Hendra won't talk, I'll find the man who used to own it.

text.id: Orang-orangnya. Tasya janji dateng. Dan Bima belum selesai ngomong.
text.en: The people. Tasya promised to come by. And Bima isn't done talking.
